title: Migrate shared SCHC vector ACK callers to authenticated session context
description: The security fix for fragment ACK handling makes FragmentSender.handle_ack_bytes require an AuthenticatedSessionContext. python/tests/test_vectors.py has two shared-vector call sites around line 318 that still call the old API, so the targeted fragmentation vector test now has exactly two API failures. The file is already dirty under another agent and was not overwritten. Migrate each sender to a bound ordered local/remote identity + fragmentation Rule ID context and provide strictly increasing 24-bit replay counters for ACKs, without weakening authentication checks or disturbing concurrent vector edits.
acceptance_criteria: All FragmentSender.handle_ack_bytes callers pass the correct bound AuthenticatedSessionContext; shared recovery/window-transition vectors pass; wrong-peer/prior-session/replay tests remain rejecting; the full focused vector test is green. Preserve concurrent changes in python/tests/test_vectors.py and run 3 independent reviews if source modules change.
close_reason: Migrated recovery/window-transition vector callers to bound AuthenticatedSessionContext with fresh replay counters; both targeted cases pass and correctness/security/robustness reviews are dry.
